_patch.name: Remove file extensions from visible wording
_patch.notes: Page kickers, the chatbot title and material descriptions no longer show .exe, .txt, .pdf, .dir or (.docx). Only display text changes: material source_file, keys and download links are untouched. Material links point to the Google Docs you converted (the site already exports a Google Doc link as a PDF for downloads).
